quest.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part I
quest.description: A rock pillar stands sentinel at Musoujin Gorge, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x4, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Hello! Excuse me, outlander. Could you hear me out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Please don't linger on this island for too long. Recently, the Tatarigami's reach has spread wider and wider.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Tatarigami"?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Yes, since the people from Sangonomiya destroyed the ward that suppressed the soul of the serpent god, the Tatarigami has spread across the island...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: As you can see, the sky is now perpetually clouded and the rain won't stop. This is all because of the Tatarigami.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Recently, one by one all the miners have fallen ill, gone insane, or fled to other islands...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Everyone's gone. There's hardly anyone living on this island anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Ironically, due to the chaos created by the Tatarigami, the Shogunate and the rebels have not been fighting over this place quite as hard.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Hmph! But if they had not destroyed our great Ogosho's ward, the island wouldn't have become such a mess in the first place!

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: What do the Commissions or dragons or serpents have to do with me, huh? They never asked my opinion before starting their cursed war!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why are you still here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Why? Because this is my home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about your family?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: They are in a safe place, but thanks for your concern. They must be waiting for me to bring them back here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: No one on the island left voluntarily. We are a family here. Anywhere else we go, we'll have to work for someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But someone had to stay and clean up the mess so that everyone else can return home eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is such a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help with?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: If it were any other child offering to help me out of the blue, I'd be laughing out loud right now...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But seeing as you're a traveler from afar who has managed to venture this deep into Inazuma, you must certainly be able to hold your own.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: I'll get straight to the point, then. The ward over there has been bothering me for a long time, maybe you could find a way to repair it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: I'm sure that this awful weather can only be due to the wards' destruction.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But please, be careful when you approach the ward. If you stare at it, it will release a burst of energy towards you...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: It's harmless, but very uncomfortable. It feels like it's... rejecting you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: I think the ward is missing some components. It can probably be fixed by putting the missing parts back.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Of course, that's just speculation on my part. I still can't say for sure what's gone wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: So, if you want to help, please help me fix this ward.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But if you can't manage it, then like I was saying — don't stick around here too long.

dialogues.speaker: Touch Ward
dialogues.text: You gaze at the ward, and suddenly, a strange energy flows towards you.

dialogues.speaker: Touch Ward
dialogues.text: You realize that it is not resisting you, but is asking you for something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something seems to be missing from this ward. Best to look around the area for the missing parts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Use your Elemental Sight to scan for scattered traces of elements nearby. Maybe you'll find something!

talks.objective: Search for the missing part to repair the ward

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: How're things going? Have you finished repairing the wards already?

response.speaker: Kaji
response.text: And if you don't manage it, just leave it. The most important thing is that you shouldn't stay in this place too long — it's dangerous.

talks.objective: Go back and talk to Kaji

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Not bad, outlander! The clouds are almost gone. It seems as though my guess was right.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Next, the two wards at the Serpent's Head and Jakotsu Mine still need to be repaired.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, I'll leave those two wards to you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Thank you very much for your help. Although I am by no means a man of wealth, I promise that you will be paid fairly.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: I still don't know when it'll happen, but it seems that the time for my reunion with family and friends is drawing a little closer...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: By the way, you can find me on the west side of the island once you're done. Fort Mumei came under rebel assault previously, and I suspect that the attack is related to these changes.

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: The strangely-shaped stone lantern seems to be emitting an ominous energy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This stone lantern is so strange... It's so creepy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, what's that written on the light post?

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: "Travelers passing through: if you have any questions about this ward, please go to the Musoujin Gorge and talk to Mr. Kaji about it."

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: The handwriting looks very recent, and there are a few lines of smaller handwriting below, which have been eroded by the rain:

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: "Please tell Mr. Kaji we've tried... But unfortunately... Maybe he can find it somewhere nearby..."

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: "Please tell Mr. Kaji to come to the refuge as soon as possible. He's dearly missed by his family."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Mr. Kaji seems to be pretty concerned about these stone lanterns. Why don't we go to Musoujin Gorge and ask him?

dialogues.speaker: Touch Ward
dialogues.text: The lantern has finally been repaired. The weather seems to have changed as well.

dialogues.speaker: Place
dialogues.text: It seems that two critical components are missing from the ward.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Submit Item
